title: Aaron Glenn: No regrets about how we handled end of regulation against Packers

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Aaron Glenn: No regrets about how we handled end of regulation against Packers
sources.description: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn's late-game decision-making came under fire in Sunday's overtime loss to the Packers, but he doesn't feel any differently about his choices after a night to sleep on it.
